{{Quote|Don't look back.|Barriss Offee, to the girl|<ref name="Realization" />}}
A '''human girl''' lived in a [[Unidentified settlement (rocky planet)|settlement]] on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky world]] during the [[Imperial Era]] when the [[Inquisitor]]s [[Barriss Offee]] and the [[Fourth Sister]] arrived, searching for a [[Unidentified human Jedi|Jedi]] rumored to be hiding there. After Offee gently questioned the [[Gender|girl]], they revealed to the Inquisitor that the Jedi was hiding in the nearby mountains. However, they then watched in horror as the Fourth Sister proceeded to murder a group of townspeople gathered nearby as punishment for harboring the Jedi. As the two inquisitors exited, Offee, uncomfortable with [[Fourth Sister|Lyn Rakish]]'s actions and [[Dark side of the Force|violent murderous outburst]], sympathetically instructed the girl to not look back at the carnage.<ref name="Realization" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The girl appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' episode "[[Realization]],"<ref name="Realization" /> released on [[May 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' Trailer Revealed}}</ref> Though unnamed in the episode, the character was identified as "Young Girl" in the credits as voiced by [[Jordyn Curet]].<ref name="Realization" /> The audio description for the episode refers to the character as a boy.<ref name="AD">{{TOTE|Realization}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>
